snip.t: Intermenstrual bleeding (IMB): bleeding between otherwise recognisable menstrual periods.
Submucosal fibroids and polyps commonly cause heavy or intermenstrual bleeding.
Metrorrhagia: older term for bleeding between periods; use intermenstrual bleeding.
snip.s: Menstrual Disorders: Amenorrhoea, Dysmenorrhoea and Cycle Abnormalities

snip.t: M – Malignancy and hyperplasia: endometrial hyperplasia/cancer; consider with postmenopausal bleeding, persistent intermenstrual bleeding, increasing age or unopposed-oestrogen risk factors.
snip.s: Abnormal Uterine Bleeding (AUB): Classification, Assessment and Management

snip.t: Intermenstrual bleeding raises the possibility of polyps, cervical disease, infection or endometrial pathology.
snip.s: Abnormal Uterine Bleeding (AUB): Classification, Assessment and Management

snip.t: Intermenstrual bleeding: bleeding between expected periods.

snip.t: Mucopurulent endocervical discharge, friability, postcoital/intermenstrual bleeding or dysuria; may be asymptomatic and can ascend to cause PID.
